༄༅/ /grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so/ /

rgya gar skad du/ sarba siddhyanta dzñe ye na byanta sā dhwa ga nā ma shāst+ra/ bod skad du*| grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/ 'phags pa ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub pa mthar phyin 'khrul med smra ba'i gtso/ /grub mtha' kun gsung thub dbang la btud nas/ /grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol mthar son te/ /grub mchog mtha' bral bsgrub phyir 'di bshad bya/ /sna tshogs lta ba'i dbye ba rnam mang yang*/ /lta ba smra ba rang gzhan sde par 'dus/ /phyag rgya bzhi dang srid rtse'i gnyen po dang*/ /mtha' gnyis spong dang thar pa 'gog bden du/ /'dod dang mi 'dod lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhi/ /de gnyis 'byed pa'i khyad par 'byed chos yin/ /phan bde mtha' dag rgyal ba'i phrin las dang*/ /rtag sprul rang rgyud mu stegs dbye ba dang*| |phyogs 'dzin nyes pa kun gyi 'byung khungs phyir/ /sdang zhugs tshul gyis gzhan sde'ang smad mi rung*/ /rang gzhan grub mtha'i dbye ba rnam mang yang*/ /lhan skyes 'khrul ba'i 'dzin stangs sgrub 'gog phyir/ /mtha' la zhen dang mtha' bral smra bar 'dus| |klu sgrub lugs las gzhan dang de nyid do/ /dang po'ang rtog dang rtog med 'dzin stangs phyir/ /phyi rol pa dang rang sde gnyis su 'dus/ /dang po nye ring dbye bas chad rtag gnyis/ /gnyis pa phyi nang dbye bas don sems gnyis| |de dag 'khrul pa'i 'dzin stangs bden zhen gyis/ /bsgrubs nas kun brtags mthar lta'i g.yang du lhung*/ /'khrul med rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i yul/ /mtha' bral mchog de klu sgrub lugs las rtogs*/ /yul can de ni mdo rgyud gzhan du sbas/ /gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lor gsal bar gsungs| |grub mtha' kun shes pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las lta ba spyir brtag pa ste le'u dang po'o// // phyi rol grub mtha' smra ba mang gsungs kyang*/ /chad smra gcig dang rtag smra sde bzhir 'dus/

/kun kyang bdag dang rtag dngos 'tshe ba smra/ /thub pa'i lugs la sdang smras byed par mthun/ /chad smra tshu rol mdzes pa rgyang 'phen pa| |med smra lha yi bla ma phur bu pa/ /ngo bo nyid smra rang bzhin rgyur smra zer| |phur bu 'jug stobs 'jig rten mig rjes 'brang*/ /'dod yon chags pas snying la rab gdungs nas/ /'byung bzhi'i bdag dang lus sems rdzas gcig dang*/ /'gro ba gsum dang gzhan grags gtan tshigs sgrub/ /skye ba snga phyi las 'bras dkon mchog gsum/ /ma mthong dngos po rjes dpag tshad ma 'gog |lnga pas bzhi pa bsgrubs nas de dang ni/ /sgrub pa bzhi yis dgag pa'i dang po sgrub/ /de yis lhag ma mtha' dag 'grub par 'dod/ /ma mthong tsam gyis med pa mi 'grub cing*/ /rjes dpag med dang gtan tshigs yod pa 'gal| |'byung sems mthong myong so sor snang bzhin du/ /gcig tu 'dod na mngon sum 'gog par 'gyur/ /rgyun ldan sems la rang rgyu sngon song dang*| |rang 'bras bskyed nges da lta'i sems kyis mtshon/ /chags sogs goms gsal nyer len nges phyir yang*/ /mi gsal 'gro ba grangs can phyugs dang mtshungs/ /rtag smra grangs can pa dang dbang phyug pa| |khyab 'jug pa dang gcer bu pa zhes bya/ /grangs can yon tan gsum pa ser skya pa/ /sum cu pa dang gtso bor pa zhes grags/ /dbye na mngon gsal pa dang rnam 'gyur smra/ /lha med pa dang lhar bcas zhes kyang bya/ /ser skya chu klung la sogs ston par 'dzin/ /tshad ma gsum gyis shes bya nyer lnga 'jal/ /dbang po'i 'jug pa mngon sum tshad ma ste/ /'brel ba bdun gyi rang don rjes dpag dang*| |rnam ldan gsal 'ongs gzhan don rjes dpag nyid/ /dbang phyug nag po'i rgyud dang drug cu pa/ /mtshan nyid lnga bcu la sogs yid ches khungs/ /shes bya gtso bdag gnyis 'dus tha ma bdag /za po rtag cing yon tan byed min shes| |gtso bo'i blor gnas ser skyas kyang mi mthong*/

/gzhan kun gtso bo yon tan bem po yul/ /rang bzhin rgyu dang rnam 'gyur 'bras bus bsdus| |thog ma dang po yon tan gsum mnyam pa/ /byed pa rtag gcig khyab cing mi gsal ba/ /de yi dngos 'bras blo'am chen po ni/ /shel ltar gsal dwangs yul shes gzugs brnyan 'char/ /gzugs 'dres mngon 'gyur yul shes lkog gyur nyid/ /de las byung ba'i nga rgyal gsum yin te/ /rmongs dang 'dod chags g.yo ba'i rang bzhin phyir/ /rdul dang rnam 'gyur 'byung ba las gyur gsum/ /dang pos sgra sogs de tsam lnga bskyed cing*/ /de lngas mkha' sogs 'byung ba lnga skyed byed/ /gnyis pas dbang po bcu gcig skyed byed cing*| |gsum pas gnyis po'i thun mong bdag rkyen byed/ /rgyu dang rang bzhin kho na thog ma ste/ /'bras bu rnam 'gyur kho na bcu drug nyid/ /gnyis yin chen po sogs bdun gnyis min bdag /thog mtha' bden grub gzhan kun rdzun pa slu| |sngar yod gsal ba'am 'gyur ba skye ba'i don/ /rang bzhin ngang du zhi ba 'jig par smra/ /bdag gis rnam 'gyur rdzun par mthong ba na/ /skyengs te rang bzhin ngang du bsdus pas thar/ /de las gzhan pa'i thar lam med pas na| |spyod lam brtul zhugs la sogs gtsor mi byed/ /rgyu ma log par 'bras bu zlog pa 'gal/ /gsum phyir gcig min myong phyir bem po min/ /rig phyir rtag min rtag la thar mi srid/ /phal cher blos btags 'ga' zhig 'thad par rung*| |dbang phyug phyugs bdag zhi ba ye srid pa/ /mig mi bzang ba 'ug pa pa zhes grags/ /drang srong rkang mig gzegs zan ston par 'dzin/ /zhi ba'i rgyud dang gzegs zan bstan bcos 'chad/ /dbye ba rig pa can pa bye brag pa| |gsal byed pa dang rna ba ma phug pa/ /dbang phyug kun mkhyen ti se ri steng gnas/ /yang dang phra dang dbang 'gyur bdag por gyur/ /gar yang phyin dang mchod 'os 'dod dgur ldan/ /dga' mgur gnas te yon tan brgyad ldan zhes|

|snod bcud mtha' dag 'dod pas khyab par ni/ /sdod 'jug sogs dang rgyu bdun 'chol bas 'grub/ /de nyid gzugs min rnam gsum gnas na gnas| |mdud pa bcu gnyis lam drug de nyid lnga/ /thig le zhi ba 'khrig pa chos su smra/ /mngon rjes nyer 'jal sgra byung tshad ma bzhis/ /rdzas dang yon tan las dang spyi bye brag /'du ba zhes bya tshig gi don drug 'jal/ /rdzas ni 'byung bzhi mkha' dus phyogs bdag yid/ /'byung bzhi'i rdul phran kun tu song min tshad| |de dang mkha' sogs mtha' dag rtag pa'i rdzas/ /'byung bzhi'i rigs pa mi rtag kun rdzas yod/ /bdag ni gson lus la brten bem po khyab/ /yon tan bcu gsum bdun lngas nyi shu lnga/ /las ni 'degs 'jog brkyang bskums 'gro ba lnga/ /spyi ni cha med khyab dang nyi tshe ba/ kha dog dbyibs yig gis stong sgra blo'i rgyu/ /gsal kun rjes 'gro thar lugs tha dad 'dod/ /bye brag dkar sogs gsal ba so so ba/ /'du ba spyi gsal rdzas yon rten brten pa/ khyad par khyad par can rnams sgrel byed gzhan/ /bdag bsgom dbang phyug dbang bskur thar lam yin/ /don drug shes pas thar pa bye brag pa/ /tshig don bcu drug shes thar rig pa can/ /de bzhin mngon sum bem po rtog par 'dod/ /rdul phran brgyud dang dbang phyug nyid kyis bskyed/ /rtag pas 'bras skyed rkyen la mi ltos phyir/ /rtag tu'am yang na nam yang skyed mi 'gyur/ /'dod la ltos na nus med mi rtag nyid/ /cha med kun khyab 'gal sogs gnod pa mang*/ khyab 'jug sred med bu pa grong 'joms pa/ /rgyal dpogs gzhon nu ma len sogs rjes 'brang*/ /rtogs phan yal ga lo ldan gsang tshig 'chad/ /dbye ba tshangs pa ba dang spyod pa ba/ /brda sprod rig byed mtha' pa gsang ba pa/ /spyod pa las gzhan thar dang kun mkhyen 'dod/ khyab 'jug lha chen nor lha gtum mo'i bu/ /sgo ldan grong na bud med mang pos bskor/

/dngos po kun gyi mchog kun de yin la/ /bram ze'i lus kyis las byed rnam smin za/ /lha rdzas ngo bo zhi dang zhi min gnyis/ /dang po bsgoms pas thar pa thob par 'gyur/ /gnyis pas khyab 'jug 'jug pa bcu byed de/ /nya dang rus sbal phag rgod mi'i seng ge |mi'u thung dga' byed rā ma nag po dang*/ /sangs rgyas rigs ldan bcu yi rim bzhin du/ /rig byed bton dang 'j-ig rten btegs pa dang/ /'jig rten mnan dang gser can bsad pa dang*/ /stobs ldan bslus dang rgyal rigs med byas dang*/ /srin po btul dang sems can don byas dang*/ /sdig pa sbyangs dang dus log rtogs pa'o/ /de ltar 'jig rten sna tshogs de yis byas/ /rtag chad lta ba gnyis ka de yis bstan/ /tshangs pa ba ni tshangs pa skye gnas gsum/ /ming bdun ldan pa lus kyi cha shas las/ /mchod sbyin snyan tshig nges rjod srid bsrung ste/ /rig byed bzhi dang mi rigs bzhi byung ba/ /rta yi mchod sbyin gtsang mas sgrub ces smra/ /spyod pa pa'am rgyal dpog pa rnams ni/ /blau bdag shes rig rtag pa'i bdag 'dod cing*| |nyes rnams skyes bu la brten rtag pas na/ /nyes zad kun mkhyen med pas bden ngag med/ /yul khrus kyis dag srid g.yul srog bsrung 'dag |mngon rjes nyer 'jal sgra byung don go dang*/ /dngos med ces bya tshad ma drug 'dod cing*/ /don go drug dang dngos med bzhir yang 'byed/ /de yi bye brag tsa ra ka pa ni/ /rigs dang ma dmigs srid pa zhes grags dang*/ /snyam sems la sogs tshad ma gzhan yang 'dod/ /shes bya mngon gyur blo ni lkog gyur yin/ /brda sprod pa ni sgra yi tshangs pa smra/ /cha med dngos kun rang bzhin rtag pa'i oṃ/ /sna tshogs de yi rnam 'gyur sgrar snang bas/ /dngos dbang sgra 'jug sbyin sreg gnyis kyis 'grub/ /phal cher tshad ma rig byed gcig pur 'dod| |bri tra ha ri mngon rjes gnyis kyang smra/

/rig byed mtha' ba shes rig skyes bu gang*/ /drang srong chen po nyi ma'i mdog ces pa/ /sa 'og mun pa'i dkyil 'khor 'og na gnas/ /sna tshogs 'di dag de yi sgyu ma'i gzugs/ /bcings thar la sogs kun gyi byed po yin/ /de zhes mkhas pa de char thim pas grol/ /gsang mtha' pa ni bzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi /rtag gcig cha med shes rig bdag bden 'dod/ /tshangs dang khyab 'jug skyon las ma grol bar/ /rang gi gzhung las mang du bshad pas bsal/ /phal cher rtag gcig cha med bkag pas khegs/ /nyes zad skyes bu brtag shing dpyad pas 'grub/ /gcer bu 'dzem med zad byed thal ba pa/ /rgyal ba phyogs mkha'i gos can kun tu rgyu/ /rgyal ba lhar 'dzin khyu mchog ldong ris dang*/ /snod kyi rje dang 'phel ba sogs rjes 'brang*/ /srog ni lus ched rdzas rtag rnam grangs gzhan| |mngon rjes lung gis dus gsum rdzas drug dang*/ /tshig dgu srog ldan drug rnams 'jal ba gzhi/ /sdom dang brtul zhugs ye shes lnga lnga dang*/ spyod pa bcu gsum las zad thabs ni lam/ /srid gsum steng na dpag tshad zhe lnga'i tshad| |dkar zhing dri zhim yid 'ong thar pa 'bras/ /'gro lnga yod pa'i lus lnga gzhi 'bras nyid/ /mngon sum spyi 'jal rtog med bye brag rtogs/ /tshul gsum 'khrul phyir gzhan du mi 'thad pa'i/ /tshul gcig nyid las lkog gyur shes pa ni| |rjes dpag yin te yid ches tshig ni lung*/ /srog bdag mkha' phyogs sdig dang bsod nams rdzas/ /srog dag srog min bcings thar 'gro 'ong spangs| |zag pa sdom pa tshig gi don dgu'o/ /'byung bzhi ljon pa 'bras bu'i srog ldan drug /gzhan du srog gi sde tshan dgur yang bshad/ /spyod lam skad tshol mi 'dor nyer gnas sdom/ /mi 'tshe bden smra tshangs spyod byin pa len| |yongs bzung thams cad gtong ba brtul zhugs lnga/ /blo gros thos mtshams dpyod dang mo'i ye shes/ /spyod pa sdom dang brtul zhugs sgo gsum gsang*|

|dmyal ba dud 'gro lha mi thar pa'i 'gro/ kham zas 'od yid rdzus skyes mtha' yi lus/ /kun mkhyen med dang shing sogs sems ldan du/ /sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs mang du 'god par byed/ /lus bzhin che chung 'gyur na de mi rtag |rdzas dang rnam grangs gcig dang tha dad brtag /tshul gcig mi 'thad gtan tshigs thams cad 'khrul/ /las zad don med thar pa gzugs su 'gal| |rā ma ṇa yi rjes 'brang stag gzig dang*/ /bod na gshen rab rjes 'brang bon la sogs/ /gnyis min mang yang gsar du blos btags phyir/ /gdod nas grub pa'i grub mtha' smra ba min/ /bdag ni phung po las gzhan ma dmigs phyir| |gcig na mtshan nyid 'gal bas bdag med grub/ /rim dang cig car don byed nus stong phyir/ /rtag dngos mi srid 'tshe la chos mi srid/ /grub mtha' kun shes pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las gang zag gi bdag gtso bor dgag pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o// // sangs rgyas pa la lnga ba med gsungs phyir/ /rang sde bye brag smra ba mdo sde pa/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa dbu ma pa dang bzhi/ /don sems ngo bo nyid med gsum du'ang 'du/ /gnyis gnyis theg dman pa dang theg chen phyir/ /gnyis pa theg chen par sdud gzhung lugs 'khrul/ /don smra gnyis ka'i 'dod pa mthun pa ni/ /longs sku rtag bzhugs byang sems bde bar 'gro/ /bdag mchog 'dod dang nyan rang 'tshang rgya bas/ /phyag rgya bzhi dang 'gal sogs mtha' yas phyir/ /theg chen spong zhing sgrib gnyis bdag med gnyis/ /kun gzhi nyon yid gnas gyur sa bcu dang*/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga sogs mi 'dod cing*/ /thams cad yod smra phal chen gnas brtan pa| |mang bkur ba bzhi gyes pa bco brgyad 'dod/ /mang bkur nang tshan gnas ma bu la sogs/ /sde pa lnga yis brjod med bdag 'dod cing*/ /bye smra'i nang tshan gzhan kun bdag med 'dod/ /dpe ston sde pa slob dpon dge srungs dang*/ /btsun pa dpal len la sogs mdo sde pa/

/kun kyang phung sogs dbye ba skye 'gro zas/ /rdul phran cha med rags pa cha bcas rdzun| |sems dang sems byung 'dus byas skye tshul dang*/ /bden bzhi lam lnga nyan rang byang sems dang*/ /phyin drug sangs rgyas dge bdun nyi shu dang*| |bsam gtan la sogs yon tan phal cher dang*/ /sangs rgyas sa na sdug bden yod pa dang*/ /lhag med gsum ga rig pa rgyun chad dang*/ /zag bcas zag med bden gnyis 'jog tshul mthun/ /zag rnams kun tu rgyas 'gyur cig shos phyir/ /lam bden las gzhan 'dus byas mtha' dag dang*| |de dang 'dus ma byas kun go rim bzhin/ /gzhig dang gsal bas rang blo mi 'dor 'dor/ /yang na don dam don byed nus mi nus/ /don dam kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid phyir/ /'di gnyis don gcig chu dang bum sogs kyis| |dam pa'i don du don byed mi nus te/ /de ni rang 'dzin 'khrul med skyed byed pa'i/ /don chos rang gi mtshan nyid la 'dod na/ /de dag brda sogs nang gi yan lag la/ /bltos pa'i blo chos kun rdzob dngos po'i phyir/ /des na dngos po tsam la don dam gyis/ khyab pa mdo sde'i lugs su smra ba ni/ /mdo sde pa la skur ba 'debs pa ste/ /bye smra las kyang chos bdag rgya che'i phyir/ /don dam bden pa rigs pas dpyad bzod kyi/ /bden par mi 'dod dngos smra med phyir ro| |ldan min 'du byed blos btags dngos por ni/ /'dod pas bye brag smra las lhag pa'ang 'gal/ /de phyir don smra gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ /mngon pa sde bdun bka' ru 'dod mi 'dod/ /lung gi dam chos 'du byed gzugs phung dang*/ /rdul phran bskor ba bar bcas bar med dang*/ /rig byed min gzugs sgrub dang 'gog pa dang/ /dbang po tshad ma gzung 'dzin rgyu 'bras kun/ /dus mnyam 'dod dang mi 'dod don snang 'di/ /phyi don nyid dang shes pa'i rnam pa dang*/ /dbyibs dang dus gsum shes bya gzhi lnga dang*/

/ldan min du byed rdzas yod btags yod dang*| |'dus ma byas rnams dngos po dngos med dang*/ /de bzhin nyid dang rang rig mi 'dod 'dod/ /bya byed ldan 'brel don gzhan don gcig dang*/ /lus shes bsam gtan yan lag mi rung rung*/ /'phags pa'i spangs rtogs nyams dang mi nyams so/ /lus sems sa bon can du mi 'dod 'dod/ /rags la rdzas brgyad 'dus pas khyab ma khyab/ /sems byung mtha' dag rdzas gzhan grub ma grub| |rten 'brel phung po tshogs dang kha yar ba/ /'di dag spyan ras gzigs dang legs ldan 'byed/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pas ji ltar gsungs pa rnams// 'khrul med legs par rtogs nas bstan pas na/ /rgya bod gzhan gyi gzhan du bshad rnams 'khrul/ /brjod med bdag ni mdzod 'grel dgu par bkag/theg chen bstan par dam pa kun gyis bsgrubs/ /bye smra'i rtog btags mdo sde pa yis bkag |de yi rang 'dod rnal 'byor dpyod pas 'gog /grub mtha' kun shes pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las bzung ba'i chos bdag gtso bor dgag pa ste le'u gsum pa'o//

// theg pa chen po mdo dang sngags kyis bsdus/ /gnyis ka'ang dbu sems gnyis su mkhas la grags/ /ci phyir rnam rig ngo bo nyid med kyi/ /tshul gnyis shing rta'i srol 'byed 'dzam gling rgyan/ /thogs med klu sgrub gnyis kyis byams 'jam dbyangs/ /brten nas dgongs pa nges 'grel mdo dang ni/ /blo gros mi zad mdo bzhin legs bkral ba/ /de dag las gzhan theg chen shing rta che| |yod pa min par mkhas la grub phyir ro/ /sher phyin mdo la 'chad tshul bzhi byung ba/ /shing rta'i srol 'byed bzhi zhes zer ba ni/ /theg chen spyi yi shing rta'i srol 'byed min/ /de phyir nyan thos sde gnyis mi 'dod pa'i/ /theg chen gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag kun/ /phal cher shing rta'i mchog gnyis bzhed tshul mthun/ /gzhan dbang yongs grub bden par snga mas bsgrubs/ /phyi mas de yang rigs tshul du mas bkag /rang rig tha snyad tsam du 'di mi bzhed/ mtshan nyid gsum dang kun gzhi'ang mi bzhed cing*/ /phyi don tha snyad tsam du 'di bzhed par| |'di na 'ga' zhig gsal por sgrogs pa na/ /byang chub sems 'grel gzhung dang 'gal bar mthong*/ /tshul gnyis rjes 'brang nang tshan so so la| |tshogs brgyad rang rig 'dod tshul sna tshogs yod/ /theg chen gnyis kyi khyad par gtso bo ni/ /gzhi la ngo bo nyid med la sogs dang*/ /lam la skye med chos la bzod pa dang*/ /'bras bu mthar thug theg pa gcig pa rnams/ /drang don nges don nyid du bzhed pas na/ /'khor lo bar mtha'i drang nges khyad par yin| |rnam rig smra ba'i gtsug rgyan sku mched gnyis/ /ngo bo nyid dang khyad par btags pa dang*/ /gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan bden pa'i kun btags te/ /rtog dang rtog med lhan skyes la snang ba'i/ /chos bdag 'di nyid 'gog la so sor brtson| |ming gi snga rol ming can blo med phyir/ /don de ming 'di bdag nyid du 'gal dang*/ /don gcig nyid la mang po'i ming ldan pas/

/don de bdag nyid mang por 'gal ba dang*/ /don gcig nyid la ming gcig ma nges pas/ /don gnyis gcig tu 'dres par 'gal bas na/ /rtog la ming don gcig tu snang ba 'di| |snang bzhin ma grub bdag med grub par 'gyur/ /rdzas gzhan snang ba'ang bdag 'di'i rtsa ba can/ /yin zhing spang bya'i rtog pa bzhi dang lnga/ /bcu dang khyad par byang sems rnam rtog bcu/ /'dir rtog nyid la brten phyir 'di bkag pas/ /shes sgrib mtha' dag 'joms par nus so zhes/ /gcen gyis theg bsdus sogs su gsal bar gsungs/ /cig car sbyar tshe so so'i phyogs blta na/ /cha bcas 'gyur zhing shar la blta ba'i ngos/ /gang yin gzhan la'ang blta na rags mi 'gyur/ /des na phyi don mi 'grub rtsod spong dang*/ /bcas pa gcung gi nyi shu pa las bshad/ /gzhan yang mi rtog ye shes dor med dang*// ris drug dgra gnyen snang ba 'gyur phyir dang*/ /sad dang rmi lam don byed mtshungs phyir dang*/ /gsal myong lhan cig dmigs pa nges phyir dang*/ /don la gnas 'dod rdul phran mi snang zhing*/ /blo la snang ba'i rags pa don gnas la// med par don smra rang yang 'dod pas na/ /don la skyes 'dra'ang 'grub pa mi srid phyir| |don snang mtha' dag chos kyi bdag 'dzin yin/ /de phyir phyi don rig pa'i dgag byar bzhed/ /tshul 'di lang gshegs dgongs pa nges 'grel sogs| |zab yangs mdo sde mang las gsal bar gsungs/ /rdul phran cha bcas zla grags bzhed zer la/ /ri rab rdul du thal ba'i gnod pa 'bab// rnam rig smra la 'dod tshul gnyis yin te/ /gzugs snang mtha' dag sems su bden pas na/ /phung khams skye mched ji snyed gsungs pa kun/ /sems kyi chos su bden par 'dod pa dang*/ skra shad sogs bzhin med pa gsal snang phyir// shel gong dag 'dra'i rang rig rang gsal nyid/ /bden par 'dod pa rnam bden rnam rdzun no/ /gnyis ka bag chags brtan dang mi brtan phyir/ /'phral dang gtan gyi 'khrul rgyu'i khyad par 'byed/

/rnam bden la yang gzung cha 'dzin cha yi/ /shes pa gnyis su bden dang rnam pa'i grangs/ /ji snyed shes pa'i grangs kyang 'dod pa dang*/ /rnam pa sna tshogs shes pa gcig nyid du/ /smra ba gsum du mkhas la grags shing grub/ /gsum ga la yang thun mong gnod pa ni/ /bden na gcig tu bden las ma 'das shing*/ /phyogs char snang 'di rdul dang mtshungs pas khegs/ /dang po gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan thal ba dang*/ /gnyis pa ris mthun rnam shes gcig nges dang*/ /gsum pa gcig dang du ma 'gal bas bkag |rnam rdzun pa yi gnyis stong rig pa de/ /yul med phyir na shes pa'i mtshan nyid med/ /bden pa de nyid rdzun par snang ba dang*/ /'brel ba med phyir rdzun snang 'byung mi rigs/ /med kyang 'byung na rgyal la'ang 'byung bar nges| |'brel ba yod na rdzun snang dngos por 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas sa na gnyis snang yod med kyis/ /rnam rdzun dri bcas dri med gnyis zhes grags/ /'di dag rtog ngor phyi rol don yang yod/ /don la gzhan rig sems dang sems byung med| |bya byed mtha' dag rtog ngo tsam du bzhed/ /de phyir 'bras rtogs gsum pa'ang 'di yi lugs/ /yin par kho bo'i rnam dpyod kho nas rig /sems tsam pa la kun gzhi bzhed mi bzhed/ /gnyis su gangs can 'di na grags mod kyi/ / sku mched gnyis kyis gsal bar bshad pa las/ /rjes 'brang la las gsal por ma brjod kyang*/ /'gog pa'i lung rigs susakyang ma brjod phyir/ /kun gzhi mi 'dod sems tsam tshad ldan dka'/ /shin tu brtan pa'i rig rgyun med mi rung| |chos kun bden gnyis mtshan nyid gsum du bsdu/ /ma grub btags pa'i gtso bdag la sogs dang*/ /rtog la gnyis snang rtog med gnyis snang sogs| |mtshan nyid yongs chad rnam grangs kun brtags yin/ /'khrul gzhi sems dang sems byung 'khrul ldan dang*/ /'khrul bral ma dag dag pa'i gzhan dbang yin/ /ngag de phyin ci ma log yongs grub kyang*/

/'khrul gzhi 'khrul bas stong pa'i stong nyid ni/ /'gyur med yongs grub ces bya 'dus ma byas/ /'di nyid rnam dag dmigs par kun kyang 'dod/ /rnam rdzun yongs grub dang po'ang der 'dod pas/ /mnyam gzhag snang bcas zhes byar grags pa yin/ /kun brtags gang yin kun rdzob bden pa dang*/ /yongs grub don dam bden par gnyis ka mthun/ /rnam bden gzhan dbang gnyis kyang kun rdzob dang*/ /rnam rdzun dag pa gzhan dbang don dam 'dod/ /mu stegs byed kyis rgyun dang rags pa rnams/ /cha med gcig tu bden par 'dod pa de/ /bye smras bkag nas rgyun can phra rab rnams/ /dam pa'i don du grub par nan gyis bsgrubs/ /de yis bya byed ldan 'brel bden 'dod pa| |mdo sde pas bkag 'brel ba sogs bden bsgrubs/ /de yis rnam pa gtod byed phyi rol na/ yod par 'dod pa rnam bden smra bas bkag /de yi shes pa'i bya byed bden grub tu/ /smras pa rnam rdzun 'dod pas bkag na yang*// 'khrul dang bya byed mtha' dag 'jog pa ni/ /gzhi rten bden grub med par ma shes phyir/ /dngos por smra ba zhes byar mkhas rnams gsung*/ /de yis bdag med stong nyid gang smras kyang*/ /rang gi ngo bos stong tshul med pas na/ /gzhan stong nyi tshe'i stong nyid kho nar zad/ khyad par shes pa skad cig cha med de/ /dus gzhan gnyis dang phrad dam ma phrad brtag/ma phrad da lta bar yang 'grub mi 'gyur| |phrad na dus gsum skad cig nyid du 'gyur/ /grub mtha' kun shes pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las 'dzin pa'i chos bdag gtso bor dgag pa ste le'u bzhi pa'o// // grub mtha' mtha' dag rang rang blo ngo na/ /mtha' gnyis bkag nas dbu ma smra bar rlom/ khyad par rnam rdzun gnyis med lta ba 'di/ /dbu mar mdo dang tshad ldan gzhung las bshad/ /bye brag klu sgrub lugs mchog 'chad pa la'ang*| |sangs rgyas bskyangs dang legs ldan 'byed gnyis kyis/ /thal 'gyur tsam dang rang rgyud sgrub byed phyir/

/thal rang gnyis su mkhas la grags shing grub/ /de gnyis rim bzhin rab tu mi gnas dang*/ /sgyu ma rigs grub pa zhes 'phags yul gyi/ /tshad ldan du mas bshad phyir dbye ba de/ /rmongs pa mtshar skyed yin zhes gsung mi rigs/ /dbu ma pa yi sgras brjod dbye ba ni/ /gnyis stong bden smra rnam rig dbu ma pa/ /snang la skur 'debs snang sel dbu ma pa/ /tha snyad tshad 'jal rigs grub dbu ma pa/ /stong nyid bden grub gzhan stong dbu ma pa'o/ /'di bzhi lung rigs ltar snang mang brten nas/ /dbu mar rlom zhing rgya cher grags na yang*| |rtog ges bslad phyir mthar 'dzin nang na bzhugs/ /thog mtha' gnyis kyis bden grub 'dod phyir dang*/ gnyis pas thabs phyogs mtha' dag spangs phyir dang*/ /gsum pas rdzun dang bslu med gzhi mthun du/ /dpyad nas smras pas 'gal 'du'i rang bzhin phyir/ /'on kyang tha snyad tshad grub 'dod na ni/ /rang rgyud 'thad phyir rgya bod mkhas mang bzhed/ /'di yang kun rdzob ma btags nyams dga'i ngor/ /'jog ces gsungs kyang rtog ger goms ches pas/ /mthun snang rten 'brel btags bral ma tshang na/ /blos btags tsam la bya byed ma mkhyen pas/ /stong dang brten 'byung don gcig mtshan nyid la/ /cung zad 'khrul phyir dbu ma chen po min/ / 'on kyang don dam rigs pas dpyad bzod 'gog /spros pa nyer zhi mthar thug don dam dang*/ /skye med rnam grangs par bzhed mtha' bral phyir| |dngos smra las lhag dbu ma kho na'o/ /'di ni rang rig mi 'dod phyi don 'dod| |'di las ldog par smra ba gnyis su 'dus/ /dang po legs ldan ye shes snying po ste/ /gnyis pa zhi 'tsho yab sras rjes 'brang bcas/ /gang dag dpal ldan zla ba'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /ma dag 'khrul pa'i snang ba tshad grub tu| |rigs pa du mas dpyad nas khas len pa/ /'di la 'gal ba'i khur chen 'di ltar yod/ /yul kun rdzun dang yul can bslu med 'gal/

/yul der 'khrul dang de la tshad ma 'gal/ /rjes dpag yod dang bsgrubs ngag med pa 'gal/ /mthun snang med dang chos can tshad grub 'gal/ /phyi don tshad grub rdul phran cha bcas 'gal| |rigs drug tshad ma rdos bcas tshad grub 'gal/ /skra shad med dang klung rnag yod pa 'gal/ /rdzas grub med dang dngos po yod pa 'gal/ /gzhan skye med dang sa myug rdzas gzhan 'gal/ /bden rdzun yod dang yang log med pa 'gal| |yan lag la dpyad bum pa mi rnyed dang*/ /skad cig la dpyad zhig pa rnyed pa 'gal/ /rang rgyud smra bas rang bzhin smras pa dang*/ /rang bzhin med blo de ngor grub pa 'gal/ /nyon mongs can min ma rig yod pa dang*/ /shes par gyur pa'i shes sgrib med pa 'gal/ /gzhung gzhan nas 'byung kun gzhi rang rig sogs| |'gog na rang lugs de dag mi 'dod dang*/ /sde bdun las gsungs tshad ma mi 'dod kyang*/ /rang lugs tshad ma'i rnam gzhag shes pa 'gal| |mi rtag sogs rtogs rnal 'byor mngon sum dang*/ /de yis sbyor lam rtogs par mi sleb 'gal/ /gzhan sems shes pa yid mngon yin pa dang*/ /bden bzhi shes pa rnal 'byor mngon gsum 'gal/ /kun mkhyen ye shes chos kun 'jal ba dang*/ /shes bya byed la tshad ma min pa 'gal/ /rdzas yod bdag smra gnas ma bur nges dang*/ /rnam shes bdag smra'i dbu sems yod pa 'gal/ /de ltar 'gal ba'i khur chen yod pa'i rgyu/ /rnam dpyad med par 'jig rten nyid las zhes/ /yang yang smras kyang rtog ger goms pa'i mthus/ /'thad pa bcug nas dpyad cing bsgrubs pas so/ /klu sgrub lugs mchog dbu ma chen po ni/ /zla bas legs bkral nyi mas bsgyur ba'i srol/ /sras bzhi las 'ongs rtog ges ma bslad pa/ /gangs can mtha' bral rtser gshegs 'gal yis gzigs| |bod yul rtog ge'i brda yis gang ba'i mthus/ /tha snyad smra brjod cung zad mi bde bas/ /mkhas rlom kun gyi blo gros ra bar ni/ /ma shong khron pa'i rus sbal ji bzhin no/

/de phyir klu sgrub yab sras sangs rgyas bskyangs/ /zla grags zhi ba lha yi gzhung mchog kun/ /ma dpyad cung zad dpyad dang legs par dpyad/ /gnas skabs gsum la sbyor bar kho bos rtogs/ /tha snyad ma dpyad 'jig rten lhan skyes ngor/ /don dam cung zad dpyad pa'i rig shes ngor| |spros bral legs par dpyad pa'i brjod med ngor/ /'di gsum legs par shes de dbu ma che/ /gang phyir gsum po 'di las rim bzhin du/ /bsod nams min pa dang por bzlog pa dang*/ /bar du bdag tu lta ba gnyis bzlog cing*| |tha mar lta ba'i spros kun bzlog phyir ro/ /de yang dang por lhan skyes 'khrul pa'i ngor/ /byed po dpyod po gcig tu 'dzin pa ni/ /rtog ges ma bslad rang dgar zhugs pa na/ /rang bzhin med pa'i las las 'bras bu 'byung*| |rtag dang mi rtag dpyad mthar rgyun dang ni/ /chud mi za sogs gzhan 'dod kun bkag nas/ /zhig dang yang zhig de'i yang zhig dngos sogs/ /bye brag smra ba'i thob pa'i dga' ston ltar/ /smras kyang thug med dang po 'grub mi srid| |de phyir skad cig cha sogs dpyad mi rung*/ /phyi nang gar yod 'gro 'ong gang byed sogs/ /'jig rten rang dgar dpyod dang 'di mi mtshungs/ /gnyis par bdag 'dzin gnyis kyi 'dzin stangs yul/ /rigs pa'i mchog gis btsal nas mi rnyed pa'i/ /skye med bden stong bslu med yul gyi mchog /de 'jal tshad mar tha snyad tsam du grub/ /des na bden stong don dam bden pa dang*/ /de yod tha snyad bden par 'thad mod kyi/ /de nyid legs par dpyad mthar 'dod pa dang*| |rnam grangs don dam du 'dod gnyis ka 'khrul/ /gsum par med dgag tsam du bzung na yang*/ /gzung 'dzin yul dang yul can ma 'gags phyir| |gnyis snang spros pa gcod par mi nus pas/ /dbyings rig chu la chu gzhag ji bzhin du/ /rig bya rig byed cung zad mi dmigs par/ /nam mkha' mthong zhes brjod ltar spros kun zhi/

/rtogs bya rtogs byed yod na byang chub ni| |min par klu sgrub zhabs kyi gsungs phyir ro/ /rig shes rjes dpag bden stong rnam ldan du/ /skyes shing de la nges shes cher 'dren pa/ /bsam byung yin gyi bsgom blo ga la yin/ /de phyir de ni mnyam gzhag sngon du 'gro/ /nges shes 'dis drangs cir yang mi 'dzin dang*/ /hwa shang lta ba mtshungs pa'i skabs med pas/ /gnyis pa sngon du ma btang rtsom 'jog dang*/ /gsum par med dgag nan 'dzin gnyis ka 'khrul/ /de phyir rang lugs gzhi lam 'bras bu kun| |cung zad dpyad ngor yin phyir lugs 'di la/ /rnam dpyod med ces smra la'ang rnam dpyod pa/ /rnam par grol sogs gsungs dang 'gal ba yod/ /de phyir bden gnyis thabs shes sku gnyis rnams/ /zung 'jug gzhi lam 'bras bur grub pas na/ /klu sgrub zhabs kyi gzhung las 'byung ba bzhin/ /cung zad dpyad ngor bdag gi 'dir brjod bya/ /bden gnyis dbye gzhi shes bya tsam du gsungs/ /dbye ngo kun rdzob bden dang don dam bden/ /mtshan nyid 'khrul ngor rnyed dang rig ngor rnyed/ /sngo dang zla gnyis 'jig rten bden rdzun phyir/ /ma dpyad yang log dbu ma rang lugs min/ /ma dpyad yul ngos bya ba byed pa yang*/ /'jig rten kun rdzob dpyad na 'di mi srid/ /rang rgyud pa yis 'di tsam dpyad nas smras/ /brtag pa ma byas zhes pa'i tshig tsam las/ /don dam yul dang yul can dngos rnam grangs| |ngo bo dbyer med mtshan nyid tha dad yin/ /de rtogs dgos pa thabs dang thabs byung rig /rtog ges brtags bzhin mtha' dag mi 'dod kyang*/ /ma brtags nyams dgar phung khams skye mched dang*/ /phyi don kun gzhi mtshan nyid gsum la sogs/ /sgyu ma'i snang ba tsam du lugs 'di bzhed/ /de phyir dngos smras don dam gang 'dod pa/ /'di yis tha snyad tsam du 'dod ces pa'ang*/ /mi 'thad dngos por smra bas gang gzhag pa/ /kun kyang rang grags 'gal 'du'i rang bzhin phyir/

/cung zad dpyad ngor ma dag las snang 'di/ /rab rib can gyi skra shad dang mtshungs pas/ /dag pa'i ye shes yul med zhir zhugs nyid/ /yul gzhan 'jal dang gzhan la ston pa sogs/ /gdul bya'i dge dang sngon gyi smon lam las/ /'byung tshul rtog ges bsam mi khyab par gsungs/ /de phyir kun rdzob nges byed 'khrul shes tsam/ /don dam nges byed gcig dang du bral dang*/ /rdo rje gzegs ma yod med skye 'gog dang*/ /mu bzhi skye 'gog rten 'brel gtan tshig rnams/ /ngo bo rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis ka dang*/ /snang tsam la dpyod chos kyi bdag med sgrub/ /dang po'i nang 'dus rnam bdun rigs pa yis/ /gang zag bdag 'gog rigs pa'i rgyal po ste/ /rtag gcig rang dbang can tsam lhan skyes la/ /snang mod 'thad pa bcug pa kun brtags yin/ /bden pa'i gcig dang du mas dben pa'i phyir| |chos kun bden par med de gzugs brnyan bzhin/

/chos can ma brtags snang tsam kho na ste/ /phyogs chos cha bcas phyir dang gcig med phyir| |bden na gnyis por nges pa med pa 'grub/ /brtags pa 'gog na rdul dang skad cig sogs/ /cha med 'dod la phyogs cha dus chas dgag /des brtsams bem rig mtha' dag bden gcig khegs/ /chos nyid nam mkha' sogs la'ang rten cha tsam/ /dngos med kun la tha snyad tsam du yang*/ /ngo bo med pas bden 'dzin chung ba'i phyir/ /gzhung du dngos po rnams la bden grub bkag |stong nyid bden med sgrub la'ang cha bcas dang*/ /rten 'brel sogs kyi gtan tshigs ma bkod par/ /dgag bya bden med kho nas bsgrub par mdzad| |gzugs brnyan bden med tsam du ma grub kyang/ /byad bzhin nyid du mi bden dpe la grub/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka gnyis min skye bral phyir/ /bden pa'i skye med dang po'i rtag sgrub ni/ /sa bon skye ba thug pa med pa dang*/ /myu gu'i skye dang mdog dbyibs mi rnyed dang*/ /mngon gsal yin na rgyu 'bras gcig min dang*// mthong dang 'gal zhing 'jig rten dang 'gal dang*/ /bya byed mtha' dag gcig tu 'gyur phyir ro/ /gnyis pa'i rtags sgrub rgyu min kun sbyar 'gyur/ /nas dang sa lu'i sa bon gnyis ka yang*/ /sa lu'i myu gu las gzhan mtshungs phyir ro// dus mnyam min la gzhan pa'i tshul mi srid/ /rgyu 'bras dus mnyam rigs pas khegs phyir dang*/ /dus mnyam 'bras bu yod med brtags pas khegs/ / 'di la 'phros nas yod med skye 'gog gsungs/ /yod la ci bya med la rgyus nus med/ /gnyis yin nges legs gnyis min mi srid do/ /gzhan skye 'jig rten tshad mas grub ce na/ /'dzin stangs 'khrul bas tshad mar mi 'thad cing*| kho bo gzhan du 'jig rten yang mi 'dod/ /ma brtag 'khrul ngor 'bras tshe rgyu gnas pas/ /las 'gags yun ring lon las 'bras 'byung 'thad/ / 'dir 'gros kun gzhi'i bag chags bden grub dang*/ /gzhan dbang yod dang phyi don med tshul bkag

/gnyis skye de gnyis khegs pa'i shugs la khegs/ /rgyu med ha cang thal zhing mthong dang 'gal/ /der 'dzin 'khrul par mngon sum 'khrul bas 'grub/ /de ltar rdo rje gzegs ma rgyas par gsungs/ /mu bzhi rgyu gcig nyid las 'bras gcig dang*/ /ldog dang gcig las du ma de las ldog /rang rgyud pa yis gnyis pa bzhi pa dang*/ /gzhan las skye dang med pa skye ba rnams/ /tha snyad tsam du ma dpyad 'dod na yang*/ /'di las lhag pa'i dpyod tshul gzhan med pas/ /'dir grub bden grub nyid du 'gyur ba'i phyir| |kun kyang tha snyad tsam du'ang 'dir mi 'dod/ /rig pa'i rgyal po rten cing 'brel 'byung ni/ /phran bltos tsam las mi 'byung chos med la/ /bden par grub na bltos pa mi srid phyir/ /lta ngan dra ba mtha' dag 'di yis gcod/ /ngar 'dzin lhan skyes 'dzin stangs kyis bzung ba'i| |bden grub bdag de 'dogs gzhi'i phung po dang*/ /gcig dang tha dad rten dang brten pa dang*/ /ldan pa lnga ru klu sgrub zhabs kyis dpyad/ /zla bas dbyibs dang tshogs pa gnyis bsnan nas/ /shing rta dang mtshungs dpyad na mi rnyed kyang*/ /rnam dpyad med par 'jig rten nyid las 'dir/ /rang gi yan lag brten nas 'dogs zhes gsungs/ /phal cher gzhan gyis brtags rnams thal bas 'gog /ma brtag gtan tshigs bgod pas rang gzhan la| |rig shes rjes dpag skyed la 'gal ba med/ /rtog ges btags pa'i rang rgyud mi srid phyir/ /rang rgyud tsam yang mi 'dod ces smra ba/ /thal 'gyur la yang ci yi phyir mi mtshungs/ /phung sogs bden bzhi kun byang mtshan nyid kun| |ngo bos grub par gsungs rnams drang don tsam/ /gzhan kun mngon pa'i mdo bzhin 'dir bzhed de/ /'jig rten ngor byas ston pas gsungs phyir ro/ /lam gyi thob bya mngon mtho nges legs te/ /de gnyis sgrub thabs dad dang shes rab ni/ /'gro ba bzhi yis chos las mi 'da' dang*/ /sgo gsum spyod pa 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'o/

/nges legs rang gzhan dbang byas dman mchog gnyis| |mngon mthor bcas pa skyes bu gsum gyis sgrub/ /yid ces dad pas dge sdig blang dor dang*/ /nges 'byung bsam pas bden bzhi'i 'jug ldog dang*| |byang chub sems kyis phyin drug spyod pa rnams/ /de gsum lam du mar me mdzad dpal bzhed/ /dman las 'bring po dbye bas theg gsum ste/ /theg pa bzhi dang grub mtha' lnga pa bkag /kun kyang stong nyid lta bas ma zin na| |gzhi lam 'bras bu'i tshul la 'khrul pa'i phyir/ /las su 'gyur mod zab mo'i snod dkon pas/ /'bras kyi phyir du ko ṭa 'debs pa ltar/ /drangs phyir gsungs te zab mo'i phyogs re nas/ /rim gyis zhugs pas bde blag grol 'gyur phyir/ /rgyal dang sems can gnyis kar gus bya yi/ /rang lta la chags gzhan la 'khrug mi bya/ /'on kyang nges legs lam kun 'dir bltos phyir| |lam gyi gtso bo mtha' bral shes rab yin/ /mnyam gzhag dngos kyi 'jog tshul khyad med kyang*/ /sbyor 'jug dbye bas lam lnga sa bcur 'gyur| |'bras bu mngon mtho lha ma'i bde ba dang*/ /nges legs byang chub gsum gyi rnam gzhag dang*/ /sangs rgyas sa yi sku gsum phrin las kun/ /phal cher theg chen mngon pa'i mdo bzhin bzhed/ /dngos kun blos btags ming yang btags yod phyir/ /tha snyad du yang rtog ges btags kun spong*/ /dpyad ngor bslu med myang 'das kho na'i phyir| |'dus byas bslu chos tshad grub med pa dang*/ /bden 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa bar nges pa'i phyir/ /des bskyed chags sogs nyon sgrib kho na dang*/ /theg gsum chos nyid gzigs tshul gcig pa'i phyir/ /mthong lam skad cig du ma med pa dang*/ /rang ngor shes bya'i snang ba nub pa'i phyir/ /phrin las bsam yas gzhan snang rnam rol rnams/ /lugs 'di'i thun mong ma yin khyad chos gtso| |sgrub byed rgyas par dbu ma che gzhung ltos/ /legs ldan shar gsum byams chos dbu ma kun/

/rang rgyud yin phyir cha mthun tsam du zad/ /mngon rtogs rgyan dang rgyud bla rtsa 'grel rnams/ /thal 'gyur gzhung du mkhas mang bzhed mod kyi/ /'dus ma byas kyis rab tu phye ba tsam/ /spangs pa rnam grol nyid la tshang ba dang*/ /gang zag bdag med la yang chos nyid tsam/ /mkhas la grags shing legs par grub phyir dang*/ /rang gzhung mang dang gong 'og 'gal 'gyur phyir/ /ma nges rigs can drang phyir gsungs pa ste/ /dngos bstan lam gyis srid rtsa mi chod pas/ /'phags lam dngos min yan lag khyad par can// 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs spang gnyen rags pa kun/ /shin tu gsal phyir lhag par gus 'jug bya/ /'di dag 'khor lo bar pa'i dngos bstan nyid/ / dbu ma'i gzhung las ji ltar bshad bzhin te/ /tha mar gzhi yi zag med shes pa nyid| |bde gshegs snying po sngags las je gsal gyur/ /la lar shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems dang*/ /gzhan du rang bzhin lhan skyes 'od gsal dang*/ /theg rtser rnam kun mchog ldan stong gzugs zhes/ /gsungs 'di cha med kun 'gro zhi zhing rtag /chos dbyings don dam bden par gsung rnams la/ /'khrul nas don dam gzhan stong rnam gzhag byung*/ kha cig bden stong nyid la der dgongs pas| |kun rdzob tu yang de dag med ces smra/ /de gnyis rtag chad g.yang du lhung bas na/ /skad cig 'jig kyang rgyun gyi rtag pa dang*/ /dri mas g.yogs kyang ngo bo zhi ba dang*/ /rig pas 'jig kyang lam gyis gzhom med dang*/ /'dzin stangs min kyang dmigs yul yin pa'i phyir/ /rtag dang zhi bden chos dbyings mig gi bstan| |'di ni tha snyad pa yi gnas lugs te/ /tha snyad tsam du rang bzhin mi 'gyur phyir/ /me yi tsha sogs 'khrul ngo'i rang bzhin tsam/ /nus ldan blau la bsil bar snang phyir ro/ /des na chos can bslu med 'dir gtogs te/ /'on kyang skad cig la bltos 'di yang slu/ /'di dang 'di yi steng gi bden stong gnyis|

|snang dang 'dzin stangs yul du byas nas ni/ /legs par goms na sangs rgyas myur 'grub phyir/ /bsgrub gzhi rang la tshang ba la dgongs nas// sangs rgyas rang la yod ces lan mang gsungs/ /'di dang thog med nas 'grogs dri ma rnams/ /shin tu mi mthun gsar du skye dgos kyi/ /yon tan mtha' dag shin tu mthun pas na/ /gzhi nas de dag nus pa'i tshul gyis ni/ gnas phyir yon tan rang chas zhes kyang gsungs/ /'di yi dri ma sbyong ba'i rim pa la/ /theg dang grub mtha' gong nas gong du gzhag /'dul ba mdo sde rdo rje theg rnams kyi/ /dngos bstan spang bya 'khor ba phra rags gsum/ /kun nyon gsum dang rang bzhin sdig pa gsum/ /'di las gdul bya dman 'bring mchog tu bzhag /'khor ba rags pa ma dag skye mchi ste/ /'di yi rtsa ba nyon mongs can rmongs yin/ /phra ba yid lus dag pa'i skye mchi ste/ /'di yi rtsa ba ma rig bag chags sa/ /shin tu phra ba phar phyin sangs rgyas te/ /'di yi rtsa ba 'pho chags phra mo yin/ /de phyir 'og ma'i rtogs pa mthar phyin kyang*/ /gong mar 'jug tshe de yi tshogs lam btsal/ /de phyir nyan rang tshogs lam nas 'jug dang*/ /sa bcu mthong lam nas 'jug rnam gzhag 'gal/ /nyon mongs las dang skye ba'i nyon mongs gsum/ /'dul ba mdo sde sngags kyi spang bya'i gtso/ /de bzhin gzugs can bdun dang yid kyi gsum/ /de gsum cha shas khyad par can rnams so/ / 'di dag thub bstan 'di la gnas mod kyi/ /gsal bar thon pa'i rnam dpyod sngar ma byung*/ /de phyir kho bo'i rnam dpyod nyi ma yis/ /mtha' dag shes bya'i gzugs kun gsal nus kyang*/ /rtag par byang du kha bltas bug pa'i sbubs/ / gsal bar ma gyur nyi mas ci zhig nongs/ /mdo sngags gnyen po'i khyad par yod bzhin du/ /spang bya gcig na nye ring tsam gzung bya/ /mdo sder gnyen po sbas na spang bya yang*/ /sbas par blo gros can gyis gsal bar rtogs/

/rdo rje theg pa'i gdul bya'i rim pa dang*/ /der bltos rgyud sde'i dman mchog de dag gi |spyi dang khyad par lam gyi rnam gzhag ni/ /thun mong min pas gzhan du bshad las shes/ /grub mtha' kun shes pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las phra ba'i bdag gnyis bkag nas mtha' bral sgrub pa zhes pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// // gang gi drin las phyi nang grub pa'i mtha'/ /rgya mtsho'i pha rol son pa'i ded dpon du/ /legs par bskrun mdzad 'jam mgon bla ma la/ /snying nas gus pa chen pos phyag bgyid do/ /rang bzhan lta ba'i mtsho chen lta 'dod cing*/ /rnam grol dbang gi rgyal po len 'dod na/ /ded dpon 'dir brten rnam dpyod grub chen la/ /dran pa'i zag lhan brtson pa'i dar tshugs shig /mkhas rlom phal cher khron pa'i rus sbal te/ /gzhan dag gang gā'i chu tsam sgrol nus kyang*/ /mtha' yas chu gter mthar son srid mtha' tsam/ /de phyir su zhig 'dir gus skye mi 'gyur| |'on kyang byis blos zab mor dpyad pa'i phyir/ /ye shes spyan ldan dag gis gzigs pa na/ /nongs pa gang mchis nongs rgyu ma rig bcas/ /ye shes me yis slar yang gzhom du gsol/ /'dir 'bad dge ba gangs ri ltar dkar des| |lhan skyes kun brtags dngos 'dzin gdon chen pos/ /yun ring gzer ba'i ma rgan 'gro ba 'di/ /myur du zhi zhing bde bas 'tsho gyur cig /ces grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos chen po 'di ni| yul byang phyogs gangs ri'i ljongs su bstan rtsis yongs grags ltar na lnga brgya pa brgyad pa'i steng dang 'thad ldan ltar na lnga pa'i sked kyi dus su byung ba| gtsang stag tshang gi lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos nyi ma zhes bya ba chu mo lug gi lo mgo can gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa'i nyin dge 'phel chos 'khor sgang du grub par bgyis pa'o//
// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral sgrub pa'i bstan bcos/ -PAGE 120--PAGE 119-- PAGE 93-
